_note: Training milestone templates (ADR 0013). subject_kind=tag, phase=training, witness_required=true (the real Training Summary forms are multi-party signed: manufacturer / GC / owner). Training is a MILESTONE, not one of the six checkout phases — it is derived and shown alongside checkout standing, never folded into 'checkout complete'. The closeout 'training' requirement (the deliverable: materials/records handed over) stays separate; this is the EVENT (people were trained, dated, witnessed). Seeded conservatively for the two operator-facing types (pumps and control panels); other equipment marks training N/A via tags.phases_na, and more types can be authored here. Wording is a maintainer domain-review item.
